lines.q: The Great Pyramid was originally what colour?
lines.a: White! Covered in polished white limestone. Didn't see that coming, right?

lines.q: Which planet has the shortest day?
lines.a: Jupiter! Under ten hours. Not Mercury.

lines.q: Last one. Botanically, bananas are what?
lines.a: Berries! And strawberries are not. Nature is weird.
